description: This file defines the base form class for creating and editing 'Meeting' records within a SuiteCRM environment. It includes methods for generating form HTML, handling form submissions, saving meeting data, and managing invitees relationships.

classes.name: MeetingFormBase
classes.description: A base form class for managing Meeting records, providing methods for rendering forms, processing submissions, and handling related invitees.

methods.name: getFormBody
methods.description: Generates the HTML form body for creating or editing a Meeting record, including fields for subject, date, and time, with JavaScript date picker integration.

methods.name: getForm
methods.description: Assembles the full HTML form for creating or editing a Meeting, including headers, submit button, and JavaScript validation.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Processes form submission to save the Meeting record, manage invitees, handle date/time parsing, and manage record relationships.
